The best part is watching the other ducks react while it carries on making an absolute mess. Here's a short clip of the ability in action: Would you let this one loose by the pool? events.title: Meet the Clown Duck — Our Pool Has Become a Circus!
events.summary: One clown duck. An entire pool of chaos. Meet the clown duck, one of the special ducks in Mayhem Duck Simulator!His trick? Blowing animal-shaped balloons from his mouth. The other ducks get so excited that they jump at the balloons. Naturally, things get out of hand.If you enjoyed this little circus, wishlist Mayhem Duck Simulator to be notified when the full game launches.
